research experience.name: UChicago | Security, Algorithms, Networking and Data Lab
highlights: Participating in research on AI agents' vulnerability analysis capabilities. Analyze reasoning and static analysis techniques within trajectories and compare them with traditional static analysis tool to explore agent's capabilities beyond human expertise.

research experience.name: Ewha Womans University | AI Security Lab
highlights: Led the development of a few-shot learning model for website fingerprinting attack. Proposed a robust framework (pre-norm, RMSNorm, and adaptive window augmentation), delivering up to 9% gains over a SimCLR-based baseline and achieving new SOTA.

Drove development of a feature embedding model for flow correlation attack. Designed a CvT-style architecture with online mining and KDE-based feature representation. Achieved 88% TPR at an extremely low FPR, establishing the real-world feasibility of the attack.

research experience.name: Purdue University | Sensor, Electro-Acoustics Technology Lab
highlights: Designed a CNN-based physical-basis (e.g., acoustic load) prediction model using the electroacoustic coupling characteristic of earphones. Led customer discovery of the proposed solution through NSF Regional I-Corps, resulting in acceptance into the National I-Corps.

research experience.name: Purdue University | Sensor, Electro-Acoustics Technology Lab
highlights: Led a team in the 3rd Clarity Prediction Challenge (CPC3), developing a speech intelligibility prediction model for hearing-aid evaluation. Designed and implemented a fundamental architecture (ASR-backboned Transformer) and training pipeline, achieving 5th place.

research experience.name: UTEP | Intelligent and Quantum Secure Advanced Cyber Defense Lab
highlights: Built a continual learning framework with a conditional tabular GAN and improved storage/training efficiency by generative replay. Drove overall experiments and achieved up to 16% improvements over the baselines (GAN and TVAE) in Class-IL/Time-IL scenarios.

research experience.name: Ewha Womans University | AI Security Lab
highlights: Led research on the first DL-based website fingerprinting model, achieving 41-55% gains over a previous SOTA. Built a Selenium crawler to collect 300K+ fresh samples over 1+ years, profiled unique data patterns, and benchmarked ML/DL baselines on a new dataset.

industry experience.name: Samyang Data Systems Inc. | Cloud Solutions Team
highlights: Led a project developing a Golang monitoring agent and E2E pipeline that collects, stores, and visualizes real-time metrics from AWS infrastructure by utilizing InfluxDB and Grafana. Deployed agents to 10+ client servers, ensuring software reliability through stress tests.
